title: Fair TP
description: A simple mod to make teleporting fairer by using XP
body:
Fair TP is a simple, lightweight mod that adds a _/warp <player>_ command to teleport to any online player. Works without OP permissions.

To keep things fair, teleporting costs XP levels. By default, warping within the same dimension costs **2 XP levels**, and warping across dimensions costs **5 XP levels**. Both values are fully configurable via the _config/fair_tp.json_ file generated on first launch.

Perfect for survival multiplayer servers where you want a fair, resource-based alternative to operator teleportation.
